# wrk-multins

HTTP benchmark using WRK across multiple network namespaces.

Launches one WRK instance per namespace (`SRV_NS`), each binding to a random
IP address. Collects throughput, requests/s, latency (median, P50, P99),
and HTTP timeout counts.

The module has no default for its variables, your test must define them:
- `SRV_NS`: number of namespaces / WRK instances
- `GEN_CONCURRENT`: total concurrent connections (split across instances)
- `GEN_THREADS`: total threads (split across instances)
- `GEN_TIME`: test duration in seconds
- `FILE_PATH`: HTTP path to request
- `HTTP_PORT`: target HTTP port
- `WRK_PROTOCOL`: protocol (http or https)

Usage:
```bash
%import@client wrk-multins GEN_CONCURRENT=128 GEN_TIME=30
```

Source: [`modules/wrk-multins.npf`](https://github.com/tbarbette/npf/blob/main/modules/wrk-multins.npf)

## Variables
